review: Manually checked against rendered original pages
applicability: National curriculum content; not local examination timings, scores, passage lengths or city vocabulary lists
scope: Grade7–9tables17–19; grouped research summaries rather than a line-by-line transcription

comprehension: Follow instructions and identify oral topic, gist, roles and intention.
Use visual/contextual cues, follow narrative development and identify key information/logical links.
Infer unfamiliar meanings in writing and briefly summarise, describe and evaluate stories.
expression: Read aloud coherently, briefly retell and participate in guided role play.
Communicate on familiar themes and complete practical tasks with understandable pronunciation.
Use prompts to write simple narratives/personal experiences and invitations; apply ordinary punctuation.

comprehension: Identify oral gist/details, speaker relationships and shifts in topic or attitude.
Follow slower broadcasts; organise written structure, distinguish facts/views and interpret visual/implicit information.
Read short biographies and simple news reports and give brief responses.
expression: Retell with coherent organisation, collaborate in drama and communicate effectively in specific contexts.
Use theme-appropriate vocabulary, structures and speech to describe experiences and give simple views.
Give short prepared talks and draft/revise texts with teacher guidance.

comprehension: Interpret everyday speaker intentions, event causes and possible narrative outcomes.
Analyse written organisation, author views, cohesion and logical relationships.
Infer vocabulary through context/word formation; take selective notes and use purpose-driven reading strategies.
Connect texts with personal/world knowledge and summarise biographies/newspaper material.
expression: Take part politely in discussion, retell others and justify feelings or evaluations.
Use prosody for meaning; adapt/create short texts orally or in writing.
Prepare, independently draft and revise writing, caption visuals and describe surrounding people/events.
Use linking expressions and self-correction for coherent, appropriate communication.

summary: Interpret explicit/implicit logic, prosodic pauses and nonverbal multimodal meaning.
Sustain conversation, combine verbal/visual description and challenge unreasonable ideas.

quantitative_caveat: Reading figures are cumulative extracurricular reading targets at the named grade. Do not sum them as annual increments or treat them as exam passage length, lexical difficulty, daily quotas or timed-test requirements. The30minute weekly figure concerns extracurricular audiovisual activity, not speaking-test duration.
